generations.name: Gen 1 (2022-2024)
generations.notes: Same platform and packs as the Gen 1 R1S: Standard (~105 kWh), Large (~128.9 kWh usable), Max (~141.5 kWh); Dual and Quad motor; CCS1 port; DC peak about 200-220 kW (general knowledge, not checked). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/722131/second-gen-rivian-r1-debut/

generations.name: Gen 2 (2025 on)
generations.notes: Second-generation R1 (MY2025, unveiled June 2024; R1T deliveries followed the R1S): LFP Standard pack (~92.5 kWh), Large ~109.4 kWh, Max ~141.5 kWh; Dual, Tri, Quad motor. Confidence: high for the boundary (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/722131/second-gen-rivian-r1-debut/ ; https://stories.rivian.com/meet-the-new-r1
